key_points: Q3 EPS and revenue modestly exceeded estimates, supporting near-term sentiment.
International growth and margin expansion offset weakness in North America.
Management expects mid-single-digit 2027 sales growth and about 15% operating margin, a constructive outlook signal.
Flat North America and the CEO's oil-supply warning temper the positive read.
The 3.8% premarket reaction suggests much of the earnings surprise may already be priced in, limiting upside from here.
